::: {#def-dic}
#### Deviance information criterion

The **deviance information criterion** is [@wikipedia_deviance_information_criterion]

$$
\operatorname{DIC} \eqdef D(\bar{\vparam}) + 2\,p_D,
$$

with $D$ from @def-bayes-deviance
and $p_D$ from @def-effective-parameters.

Source: @wikipedia_deviance_information_criterion.
:::
